main_story.headline: Supply location ambiguity creates regional confusion
main_story.lede: Residents spent the morning attempting to verify the precise coordinates of a supply cache left by a traveler.
main_story.body: The regional morning routine was marked by a brief but notable logistical uncertainty regarding the whereabouts of a supply chest. Gia initiated the discussion by noting that Nell had deposited resources near the old tower, though the location remained unspecified. The lack of geographic detail prompted Hale to request clarification, specifically questioning whether the intended destination was the east tower or the flooded tower. As Gia was unable to provide further detail regarding which old tower was referenced, the matter remains unresolved. The lack of specifics has led to a minor lapse in supply retrieval efficiency.
